name: Roblox Open Cloud
description: Roblox Open Cloud APIs for publishing place files, inspecting universes and places, operating on supported Studio instances, sending cross-server messages, restarting servers, and polling asynchronous operations.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Open Cloud API Key
credential_fields.description: API key created in Creator Dashboard with the universe resources, operations, and IP restrictions required by the tools you use.

tools.name: introspect_api_key
tools.description: Inspect the identity and access configuration associated with the current Roblox Open Cloud API key.

tools.name: get_universe
tools.description: Get metadata for a Roblox universe accessible to the API key.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Get metadata for a place inside a Roblox universe.

tools.name: publish_place_version
tools.description: Upload and publish a Roblox place file. Supply an rbxl binary or rbxlx XML file through a runtime binary handle and grant universe-places:write access to the API key.

versionType.description: Publish live or save without publishing.

file.description: rbxl/rbxlx bytes as a blobref:// handle or runtime binary envelope. Use application/octet-stream for rbxl and application/xml for rbxlx.

tools.name: list_instance_children
tools.description: Start an asynchronous Open Cloud operation that lists children of an instance in a collaborative Roblox Studio session.

tools.name: get_instance
tools.description: Start an asynchronous operation that reads a supported script instance from a collaborative Roblox Studio session.

tools.name: update_instance
tools.description: Start an asynchronous operation that updates supported properties of a Script, LocalScript, or ModuleScript in a collaborative Roblox Studio session.

request.description: Documented update request, normally containing engineInstance.Details for the supported instance type and properties. Maximum request body is 200 KB.

tools.name: poll_operation
tools.description: Poll the full Roblox Open Cloud operation URL returned by an asynchronous instance request until done is true.

tools.name: publish_message
tools.description: Publish a message to a Roblox universe topic for delivery through MessagingService to live servers.

tools.name: restart_servers
tools.description: Request a restart of active servers for a Roblox universe so players migrate to fresh instances.
